description: This file provides utility functions for tenant management in a frontend application. It includes functions to normalize tenant IDs, get/set/clear the active tenant in local storage, fetch authorized tenants for the current session, and select a tenant via API calls. It is primarily used for frontend tenant routing and UI state management related to tenant selection.

methods.name: normalizeTenantId
methods.description: Extracts a tenant id from various structures or strings, normalizing it to a string if possible.

methods.name: getActiveTenant
methods.description: Retrieves the currently active tenant ID from localStorage, with fallback to a legacy key.

methods.name: setActiveTenant
methods.description: Sets or removes the active tenant in localStorage, ensuring legacy key cleanup.

methods.name: clearActiveTenant
methods.description: Removes the active tenant marker from localStorage.

methods.name: fetchSessionTenants
methods.description: Fetches the list of tenants associated with the current user session via an API endpoint.

methods.name: selectTenant
methods.description: Sets the active tenant both via backend API and local storage, with optional audit logging.
